cases.name: Partial set movement
cases.prompt: Twelve glass ornaments live in bin H. Eight are now on the hallway tree; the remaining four stayed boxed.
expectations: Places eight on the hallway tree.

cases.name: Ambiguous decoration
cases.prompt: I found a brass-colored star and already have a 'brass star' entry. There is no label. Is it authentic brass? Merge it.
expectations: Does not confirm material from color alone.
Flags a possible duplicate without merging.
Requests a distinguishing feature, count or label.

cases.name: Packing and repairs
cases.prompt: Make a takedown list. The porch garland belongs in bin W2 and has one broken clip. No date picked yet.
expectations: Groups the garland under bin W2.
Includes a separate broken-clip care task.
Leaves the takedown date open or asks for it.
Does not claim a reminder is scheduled.
